# Discord Creator Asset Studio

> Free, 100% in-browser digital asset studio for Discord creators. Resize, validate, crop, and compress custom emojis, stickers, banners, avatars, and role icons with zero server uploads and zero quality loss.

All image processing executes locally in the browser via Web Workers and the HTML5 Canvas API. No media, filenames, or EXIF data are ever transmitted to a server.

## Core Utilities
- [Discord Banner Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/banner/): Format server banners (960×540 / 1920×1080 16:9) with top 48px safe zone overlay and user profile banners (680×240).
- [Discord Emoji Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/emoji/): Format custom emojis to 128×128 pixels strictly under 256 KiB with real-time 32×32 chat preview.
- [Discord Sticker Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/sticker/): Validate and resize stickers to exact 320×320 dimensions under 512 KiB. Animated APNG max 5s / 60 FPS.
- [Discord Avatar Cropper](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/avatar/): Crop square 512×512 profile pictures and server icons with a circular preview mask.
- [Discord Role Icon Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/role-icon/): Format 64×64 role icons under 256 KB for Boost Level 2 servers.
- [Discord Image Compressor](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/image-compressor/): Shrink PNG, JPG, and WebP under the 10 MB free upload limit (50 MB / 500 MB Nitro tiers) via iterative quality step-down, keeping original pixel dimensions.
- [Discord Image Resizer](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/image-resizer/): Scale any image to exact Discord dimensions (avatar 512×512, sticker 320×320, emoji 128×128, role icon 64×64, server banner 960×540, profile banner 680×240) with fit, fill, or stretch modes.
- [Discord Spoiler Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/spoiler/): Wrap text in Discord's ||spoiler|| markup or rename an image with the SPOILER_ filename prefix to blur an attachment until clicked. Text and image modes, fully in-browser.
- [Discord Color Palette & Hex Codes](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/colors/): Reference hex values for Discord's dark backgrounds (#313338, #2B2D31, #1E1F22), light theme, brand blurple (#5865F2), and status colors, with a click-to-copy HEX/RGB/HSL picker.
- [Discord Timestamp Generator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/timestamp/): Convert any date/time into Discord's <t:UNIX:style> markup for all seven style codes (t, T, d, D, f, F, R) with live preview; timestamps render in each viewer's local timezone.
- [Discord Emoji Copy & Paste Board](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/emoji-copy-paste/): Curated click-to-copy grid of Unicode emojis and popular kaomoji (smileys, hands, hearts, symbols, animals, food, activities, text faces) that paste into any Discord chat without Nitro.
- [Discord Font Generator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/fonts/): Convert text into fancy Unicode fonts (sans/serif bold, italic, script, fraktur, monospace, small caps, double-struck, bubble, squared, full-width, upside-down) for names, bios, roles, and chat. Readable styles first, per-style one-click copy, localStorage favorites, and "renders where" hints (nickname/bio yes, @username no). Pure client-side, no Nitro.
- [Discord Colored Text Generator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/colored-text/): Style words with ANSI color codes inside a ```ansi code block — eight foreground colors, eight background highlights, bold, and underline. WYSIWYG editor with live preview mirroring Discord's Solarized rendering; copies a ready-to-paste block. Colors show on desktop and web (older mobile shows plain). Pure client-side, no Nitro.
- [Discord Markdown Previewer](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/markdown/): Live editor for Discord's markdown flavor — bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, spoilers, inline code, fenced code blocks, headers, subtext, block quotes, lists, and masked links. Formatting toolbar wraps the selection; the right pane renders a Discord-accurate chat preview. One-click copy of the raw markdown. Pure client-side, no network.
- [Discord Embed Builder](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/embed-builder/): Visual form for a rich embed — color bar, author, title, description with markdown, inline fields, thumbnail, image, footer, timestamp, plus webhook message content/username/avatar. Live Discord card preview and a valid webhook JSON payload (color as decimal int, empty parts omitted) with one-click copy. Optional one-click send to a user-supplied webhook URL that is held in memory only — never stored, never in the JSON, never sent anywhere but Discord. The single outbound request on the whole site; everything else is pure client-side.
- [Discord Server Icon Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/server-icon/): Pan/zoom framing onto an exact 512×512 canvas with a live rounded-square server-list preview and PNG export. Animated GIF icons require Server Boost Level 1.
- [Discord Logo & Badge Maker](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/badge-maker/): Generate an original 512×512 text/emoji server badge over a solid or gradient background in circle, rounded-square, or square shapes. Trademark-safe — does not use Discord logos or brand marks.
- [Discord GIF Compressor](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/gif-compressor/): Decode an animated GIF's frames in-browser (ImageDecoder) and re-encode smaller with scale, palette-reduction, and frame-skip controls to fit the 256 KiB emoji cap or 10 MB chat limit.
- [Discord Snowflake Decoder](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/snowflake/): Decode any Discord snowflake (user, message, channel, or server ID) into its creation date in UTC/local/relative time, internal worker ID, process ID, and increment, plus ready-to-paste `<t:UNIX:F>` timestamp markup. Optionally enriches a user ID with its public avatar and banner via the Lanyard API. The decode itself is pure client-side math with no network request.
- [Discord Permission Calculator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/permissions-calculator/): Tick a role or bot's permissions to get the exact permissions integer (BigInt bitfield, all 40+ flags), decode any existing integer back into checkboxes, load Admin/Moderator/Member/Read-only presets, and build the OAuth2 bot invite URL from a Client ID. Pure client-side math, no login.
- [Discord Username Generator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/username-generator/): Generate Discord username ideas across nine styles (pronounceable, word-combo, aesthetic, leetspeak, and gaming/anime/dark/cute/cyber theme banks) with an optional 3, 4, 5, or 6-letter exact-length mode. Every idea follows Discord's handle rules (2–32 chars, lowercase a-z 0-9 `_` `.`). Click to copy, star to save favorites in localStorage, copy-all. Client-side only; cannot check live availability.
- [Discord Bio Template Generator](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/tools/bio-generator/): Build a Discord "About Me" bio from copy-paste templates or themed word banks (aesthetic, cute, gaming, dark, minimal, motivational, funny, music), each kept under Discord's 190-character limit. Live code-point counter, click-to-insert aesthetic symbols/dividers/kaomoji, copy, and save favorites in localStorage. Client-side only.

## Documentation & Reference Guides
- [Discord Asset Sizes Guide (2026)](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/guides/discord-sizes/): Complete verified reference of all official Discord image dimensions, file byte limits, formats, and Nitro gating tiers.
- [Discord GIF Maker Guide](https://discord-creator-asset-studio.pages.dev/guides/discord-gif-guide/): Engineering guide for animated Discord assets, frame rate optimization, palette quantization, and the 256 KiB ceiling.

## Verified Discord Asset Specifications
- Custom Emoji: 128×128 px max, ≤256 KiB (262,144 bytes binary), PNG/JPEG/WebP static, GIF animated.
- Custom Sticker: exactly 320×320 px, ≤512 KiB (524,288 bytes), PNG static / APNG animated (≤5s, ≤60 FPS).
- Server Banner: 960×540 px (16:9), Boost Level 2 static / Level 3 animated GIF, ≤10 MB.
- Profile Banner: 680×240 px (17:6), requires Nitro, ≤10 MB.
- Avatar / PFP: 512×512 px recommended (1:1, circular crop), ≤8 MB, PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF.
- Role Icon: exactly 64×64 px, ≤256 KB, requires Boost Level 2 + Manage Roles permission.
